title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E01 — Farhampton
Ted recounts a story about leaving a note for Victoria's ex-fiance (Thomas Lennon) in hope of calming Robin, who is anxious on her and Barney's wedding day.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E02 — The Pre-Nup
When Barney prepares a comprehensive prenup, the other guys decide to propose relationship amendments to their significant others; Quinn is furious and makes a prenup of her own.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E03 — Nannies
Marshall and Lily discover their trouble finding a nanny is a result of one of Barney's schemes; Ted and Robin argue over whose relationship is more serious.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E04 — Who Wants to Be a Godparent?
Lily and Marshall test their friends to see who would be the best godparents.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E05 — The Autumn of Breakups
As Ted and Victoria consider the future of their relationship, Ted asks Lily and Marshall for advice; Robin is concerned when she learns that Barney's new wingman is a dog.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E06 — Splitsville
Barney takes matters into his own hands when Robin is hesitant to end things with Nick; Marshall and Lily desperately want some private time.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E07 — The Stamp Tramp
Marshall ends up having to do damage control after his friend, Brad (Joe Manganiello), interviews for a job at the firm; Robin negotiates Barney's return to the strip club circuit.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E08 — Twelve Horny Women
In the biggest case of his career, Marshall faces off with his archenemy, Brad (Joe Manganiello); the gang remembers delinquent moments from their teenage years.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E09 — Lobster Crawl
Robin is determined to hook up with Barney one more time; Ted substitutes for Marvin's nanny.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E10 — The Over-Correction
Robin is suspicious of Barney's relationship with Patrice; Marshall makes a disturbing discovery about his mother.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E11 — The Final Page Part One
Ted wonders if he should tell Robin that Barney plans to propose to Patrice; Lily and Marshall run into an acquaintance from college.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E12 — The Final Page Part Two
Ted wonders if he should tell Robin that Barney plans to propose to Patrice; Lily and Marshall run into an acquaintance from college.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E13 — Band or DJ
Robin insists that Barney ask her dad for permission to marry her; Ted tries to bury his feelings by throwing himself into wedding planning.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E14 — Ring Up
Barney asks Ted to keep dating Carly (Ashley Benson), a much younger woman, even though she and Ted have nothing in common.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E15 — P.S. I Love You
Barney finds an episode of Robin's "Underneath the Tunes" as Robin Sparkles; Lily and Marshall fear that Ted's new girlfriend is a stalker.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E16 — Bad Crazy
Ted is reluctant to break things off with his unstable girlfriend (Abby Elliot); Robin holds Marvin for the first time.

title: How I Met Your Mother
description:
S08 E17 — The Ashtray
When the Captain (Kyle MacLachlan) calls Ted unexpectedly, the gang remembers their last awkward encounter.
